name: Neighborhood kids' Minecraft server social hub

mentions.name: Neighborhood kids' Minecraft server social hub
mentions.description: A Minecraft server set up for neighborhood kids that has turned into a social hub for the author's daughters, complemented by walkie talkies bought for the neighborhood kids.
mentions.problem: The family is trying to delay giving their kids phones for as long as possible.
mentions.audience: Neighborhood kids and the author's daughters.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've started buying walkie talkies for neighbourhood kids and set up a Minecraft server which has turned in to a sorta social hub for my daughters- we're trying to delay phones as long as possible
